series.name: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)
series.notes: Base faults 01/02/05/07 + parallel 60/71/72/80–86 from ManualsLib Elego 6KW p34/p49. Parallel numbers align with Voltronic twin (exact event list). 10–15KW/Oyster full tables still partial (403).

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Load connected above the inverter rating
causes.ur: Inverter rating se zyada load laga hua hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the AC supply before touching any wiring; take extra load off the output.
solutions.ur: Koi wiring chunein se pehle inverter band karke AC supply isolate karein; output se extra load utarein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter on the output and keep it below the inverter rating, then power on and retest.
solutions.ur: Output par clamp meter se load naap lein, load ko inverter rating se kam rakhein, phir on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the overload returns even with a light load, let a technician check the output board and relay before restarting.
solutions.ur: Halka load hone par bhi overload wapas aaye to restart se pehle technician se output board aur relay check karwayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Poor ventilation or weak fan raising internal temperature
causes.ur: Hawa ka rasta band ya fan kamzor hone se andar temperature barh gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the AC supply, then let the unit cool for 10–15 minutes before opening or probing.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC supply isolate karein, phir kholein ya probe karne se pehle unit ko 10–15 minute thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Check that inlet and outlet vents are clear and the fan spins freely; remove dust and replace a jammed fan.
solutions.ur: Inlet/outlet vents khuli hain aur fan azaad ghoom raha hai check karein; dust nikalein aur fan atka ho to badlein.

solutions.en: If it still overheats, a technician checks the internal temperature sensor and heatsink contact.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi zyada garmi aaye to technician se andar ka temp sensor aur heatsink contact check karwayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

title.en: Power feedback / battery not allowed after comm

meaning.en: Parallel feedback protection or BMS forbids charge/discharge.
meaning.ur: Parallel feedback ya BMS charge/discharge allow nahi.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: BMS or parallel feedback wiring not allowing charge/discharge
causes.ur: BMS ya parallel feedback wiring charge/discharge allow nahi kar rahi

solutions.en: Power off all units and isolate AC before touching parallel or battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Parallel ya battery wiring chunein se pehle sab units band karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel communication cable seating and BMS settings, and make sure every unit runs the same firmware.
solutions.ur: Parallel communication cable theek se lage hain aur BMS setting check karein, aur har unit par same firmware ho.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting — if the protection stays, send the unit to a technician or repair centre.
solutions.ur: Baar baar restart na karein — protection bani rahe to unit technician/repair centre bhejein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

meaning.ur: Parallel units mein firmware alag alag hai.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Parallel units running different firmware versions
causes.ur: Parallel units par firmware versions alag alag hain

solutions.en: Power off every parallel unit and isolate AC before opening or re-cabling.
solutions.ur: Kholne ya cable badalne se pehle har parallel unit band karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Open the menu on each unit and compare the firmware versions; flash mismatched units to one version.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka menu khol kar firmware versions compare karein; jo version alag ho use ek hi version par update karein.

solutions.en: Power up the master first and then the slaves; if the fault returns, the unit goes to a technician or repair centre.
solutions.ur: Pehle master on karein phir slaves; fault wapas aaye to unit technician/repair centre bhejein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

meaning.ur: Parallel units ka current share barabar nahi.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Uneven load share or loose parallel current link
causes.ur: Load share barabar nahi ya parallel current link dhila hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking parallel links and load distribution.
solutions.ur: Parallel links aur load distribution check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel cable connections and that the load is spread evenly; re-seat any loose link.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable ki connections check karein aur load barabar banta ho; koi link dhili ho to dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure each unit's output current with a clamp meter; a unit that still does not share must go to a technician.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka output current clamp meter se naap lein; jo unit share nahi kar rahi use technician ko dikhayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Loose or damaged CAN communication cable between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan CAN cable dhili ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before touching the CAN or parallel communication cable.
solutions.ur: CAN ya parallel communication cable chunein se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check both ends of the cable for loose plugs, damage or wrong daisy-chain order and re-seat them.
solutions.ur: Care ke dono kone loose, kharab ya ghalat order mein lage hain check karein aur dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Power cycle the whole parallel system together; if the CAN fault stays, a technician or repair centre is required.
solutions.ur: Poora parallel system saath mein ek baar restart karein; CAN fault bani rahe to technician/repair centre zaroori.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Master unit powered off or communication cable disconnected
causes.ur: Master unit band ho ya communication cable khuli ho

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the parallel wiring.
solutions.ur: Parallel wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the master unit is powered on and its communication cable is seated; re-seat or replace the link cable.
solutions.ur: Master unit on hai aur uski communication cable lagi hai confirm karein; link cable dobara lagayein ya badlein.

solutions.en: Start the master first and then the slaves; if the master is still not seen, send the system to a technician.
solutions.ur: Pehle master start karein phir slaves; master phir bhi nazar na aaye to system technician ko bhejein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Parallel communication interrupted or units started in wrong order
causes.ur: Parallel communication toot gayi ya units ghalat order mein shuru huin

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the parallel connections.
solutions.ur: Parallel connections check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the communication cables and that all units are powered from the same supply; re-seat loose plugs.
solutions.ur: Communication cables check karein aur sab units ek hi supply se chal rahe hon; loose plugs dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Power up the whole system in one go; if sync is lost again, a technician checks the parallel board.
solutions.ur: Poora system ek saath start karein; sync dobara toot jaye to technician parallel board check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

meaning.ur: Units alag battery V dekh rahe.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Loose battery terminals or different battery bank at each unit
causes.ur: Battery terminals dhile ya har unit ki battery bank alag hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and disconnect the battery before measuring anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi naapne se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at each unit's battery terminals with a multimeter; all units should read the same bus voltage.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har unit ke battery terminals par voltage naap lein; sab units par same bus voltage aana chahiye.

solutions.en: Tighten and clean loose or corroded battery connections; if readings still differ, a technician checks the battery sense wiring.
solutions.ur: Dhile ya zang lage battery connections kassein aur saaf karein; reading phir bhi alag aaye to technician battery sense wiring check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Units fed from different or unstable AC supplies
causes.ur: Alag ya unstable AC supply par chal rahe hain

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the AC supply before measuring the input.
solutions.ur: Input naapne se pehle power off karke AC supply isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the AC input voltage at each unit with a multimeter; every unit should see the same supply.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har unit par AC input voltage naap lein; har unit ko wahi supply nazar aani chahiye.

solutions.en: Check input breaker and terminal tightness; if the supplies differ, correct the wiring or call the utility or technician.
solutions.ur: Input breaker aur terminals ki quality check karein; supply alag ho to wiring theek karwayein ya utility/technician ko bulayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Uneven load distribution across parallel units
causes.ur: Parallel units par load barabar nahi banta

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current of each unit with a clamp meter; the load should be shared equally.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har unit ka output current naap lein; load barabar banna chahiye.

solutions.en: Rebalance the load across the units; if it stays unbalanced, a technician checks the output board and relay.
solutions.ur: Load ko units mein dobara barabar baant dein; phir bhi unbalance rahe to technician output board aur relay check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Output mode menu set differently on the units
causes.ur: Units par output mode ki setting alag alag hai

solutions.en: Note the current value of menu #28 shown on each unit before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch badalne se pehle har unit par menu #28 ki maujuda value note karein.

solutions.en: Set menu #28 to the same value on all units; a different output mode setting triggers this fault.
solutions.ur: Sab units par menu #28 ek hi value par set karein; alag output mode setting is fault ko chala deti hai.

solutions.en: Save, then power cycle the whole system; if the fault remains, a technician checks the parallel settings.
solutions.ur: Save karein, phir poora system restart karein; fault bani rahe to technician parallel settings check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

meaning.en: Fan fault on Elego base reference list.
meaning.ur: Elego base reference list par fan fault.

causes.en: Fan
causes.ur: Pankha kharab hai

causes.en: Fan connector loose or fan supply wire broken
causes.ur: Fan ka connector dhila ya supply wire tooti hui hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC; treat DC terminals as live even with the breakers off.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC isolate karein; breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan by hand — a jammed fan or broken blade must be replaced, and the fan connector should be checked.
solutions.ur: Fan ko haath se ghuma kar dekhein; fan atka ya blade toota ho to badlein, aur fan ka connector bhi check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan is free, a technician measures the fan supply on the board and replaces the fan if it fails.
solutions.ur: Fan azaad ho to technician board par fan ka supply naap le aur fan fail ho to use badal de.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

causes.en: Short
causes.ur: Short circuit hai

causes.en: Output wiring shorted or load insulation damaged
causes.ur: Output wiring mein short hai ya load ki insulation kharab hai

solutions.en: Treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori
